title: Due Day, Autopay and Term Extension Requests on Home Comfort Financing Accounts
content:
Borrower-requested servicing changes on a Home Comfort Financing account.

## Due-day changes

A borrower may move the payment due day to any day within the plan's allowed due-day range, at most the plan's allowance of due-day changes in any 12 months, and the new day applies from the next statement. A due-day change is accepted only while fewer than the plan's allowance of changes have been made in the preceding 12 months. The count is of changes to the due day on the account in the rolling 12 calendar months ending on the date of handling.

| Due-day changes already made in the preceding 12 months (allowance of 1, hypothetical) | New due-day change |
|---|---|
| 0 | accepted, to a day within the allowed range |
| 1 | not accepted |

## Autopay

Autopay may be turned on or off at any time on an active or delinquent account.

The clause "while autopay is enrolled on a plan whose autopay APR reduction is above 0.00, the APR is reduced by that many percentage points from the next statement and restored when autopay ends" is **no longer in force**. It has been superseded and is no longer the basis on which an autopay reduction enters a rate.

## Term extensions

A term extension is never granted where the plan's maximum term extension is 0 months.

## Illustration (hypothetical)

A borrower whose payment is due on the 3rd asks in May to move it to the 20th; no due-day change has been made on the account in the preceding 12 months. The change is accepted and the 20th applies from the next statement. A further request in August to move it to the 25th is not accepted, because one change has already been made in the preceding 12 months against an allowance of 1.

superseded_clauses: while autopay is enrolled on a plan whose autopay_apr_discount_pct is above 0.00, the APR is reduced by that many percentage points from the next statement and restored when autopay ends
